title: Evaluation Rubric — TeamFlow Lite Benchmark
designPrinciple: Every dimension must be objectively measurable. No subjective grading. Each dimension has clear pass/fail or scored criteria with defined evidence requirements.

dimensions.name: Requirement Coverage
dimensions.description: How many of the 11 functional requirements (FR01-FR11) are fully implemented?
evidenceRequired: Manual inspection of code by evaluator
API endpoint existence verified via curl/HTTP client
UI page existence verified via screenshot or browser check
dimensions.antiGaming: Cannot claim coverage without verifiable endpoint or UI page
checklist: FR02: Team CRUD with owner controls
FR04: Task CRUD scoped to team
FR05: Status workflow with valid/invalid transitions
FR11: Error handling and validation on all endpoints

dimensions.name: API Contract Correctness
dimensions.description: Do all 21 API endpoints exist, accept correct inputs, return correct outputs, and handle errors properly?
evidenceRequired: curl-based endpoint verification log
Response status code verification
Response body schema verification
Error response verification for invalid inputs
dimensions.antiGaming: Placeholder endpoints returning 200 with empty body do not count
subChecks: Activity/Audit endpoints (2): activity feed, audit log

dimensions.name: Database Schema Quality
dimensions.description: Does the database schema have proper constraints, indexes, relationships, and normalization?
evidenceRequired: Schema file or migration file readable by evaluator
Foreign key constraints verified
Unique constraints verified
Index existence verified

checklist.item: Foreign keys defined on all relationships
NOT NULL constraints on required fields
Indexes on filter/sort columns (status, assignee, due_date)
ENUM or CHECK constraints on status, priority, role

dimensions.name: Authentication & Authorization
dimensions.description: Is authentication correct? Are permissions enforced server-side on every protected endpoint?
evidenceRequired: Automated test results or manual curl log showing boundary tests
Each check must have a specific test case

checklist.item: User A cannot access Team B tasks → 403
User A cannot access Team B audit log → 403
JWT includes user ID and validates on every request

dimensions.name: UI State Coverage
dimensions.description: Does each UI page handle loading, empty, error, and success states?
evidenceRequired: Screenshots or browser inspection showing each state
At minimum, code inspection showing state handling components

checklist.item: Login/Register: error states (invalid creds, duplicate email)
Dashboard: empty state (no teams), loading, error
Team View: empty state (no tasks), loading, error
Task Detail: loading, error, edit mode, comment empty state
Team Members: empty state, loading, error
Audit Log: empty state, loading, error
Overdue Tasks: empty state, loading, error

dimensions.name: Audit Trail Completeness
dimensions.description: Are all important actions logged in the audit trail?
evidenceRequired: Audit log entries verified after performing each action type

checklist.item: Audit entries include actor, action, target, timestamp

dimensions.name: Test Quality
dimensions.description: Do tests exist with meaningful assertions? Are they not placeholder/fake tests?
evidenceRequired: Test run output showing pass/fail counts
Test source code inspection for meaningful assertions
dimensions.antiGaming: Test files with only assert(true) or no assertions count as 0

checklist.item: Auth service tests with real assertions
Task CRUD tests with real assertions

dimensions.name: Documentation Quality
dimensions.description: Is documentation complete, accurate, and runnable?
evidenceRequired: README.md content inspection
Successful run-following of documented setup commands

checklist.item: Setup instructions are accurate and work
API overview or endpoint list in docs

evaluatorMustNot: Be the same agent that performed the run
Accept file counts as quality proof
Accept export counts as quality proof
Accept agent counts as quality proof
Modify rubric after seeing run results
Show favoritism toward any run configuration
